name: Forgotten Standard Bearer
lore: A remnant of a removed civilization whose name cannot be safely spoken. It carries a banner that remembers wars the Codex refuses to restore.
visualDescription: Tall armored remnant with faceless helm, shredded banner of erased sigils, rusted mythic plate, ash falling upward.
mapBehavior: Buffs lesser Hollow enemies and creates denial zones.

scaling.campaign: Fixed mission bands; old wins should become easier as Divine Level and gear rise.
scaling.eliteRemix: +12% hp, +10% damage, +1 mechanic layer, +1 tactical AI priority.
scaling.endgame: Dynamic scaling is capped at player effective level +8; adds mechanics before raw hp.
scaling.levelFormula: hp = baseHp * (1 + 0.045 * missionLevel); damage = baseDamage * (1 + 0.035 * missionLevel), capped by tier budget

aiProfile.counterplayWindow: Every major action has a telegraph or setup turn unless spawned as a minor swarmer.

balanceNotes: Harder solo tuning: Elite GUARDIAN pressures one active deity through behavior first, stats second; threatWeight 4.0 controls encounter budgets.
